description: Turn a checklist — including one the user has tailored — into a link that opens it in the free Wilderness Times checklist builder, where items tick off and it exports to PDF, Excel, Google Sheets or print with the gear links intact. Use this whenever someone has customised a list, or asks to save, share, print, download or get a PDF of THEIR list. Takes the same arguments as build_checklist, so you can share whatever you just built.

activity.description: Base activity. One of: camping, backpacking, hiking, winter-camping, cabin-camping, couples-camping, kayak-camping, motorcycle-camping, toddler-camping, beach-camping, fishing, snowboarding.

exclude.description: Optional. Item names to leave out.

name.description: Optional label, e.g. 'Yosemite, October'. Shown when the link is opened.

name: share_checklist
title: Share a checklist link
